facts.fact: Guleid Osman writes that EVC Plus is Somalia's leading mobile-money platform, used by households to buy food, pay school fees and rent, and send money.
Guleid Osman writes that the Central Bank of Somalia states SIPS supports real-time transfers among banks, mobile wallets and points of sale.
Guleid Osman writes that the Central Bank of Somalia launched the Somali Payment Switch and SIPS, which it states connects banks, mobile wallets and points of sale in real time.
